continuous_imputation: Fitted deterministic IterativeImputer; median initialization; BayesianRidge regressions; 4 fitted rounds, 20 stored steps. No refitting on user inputs.
binary_imputation: Fitted most-frequent categories; COPD=0, ASA III=0, oxycodone=0.
preprocessing: Per-component fitted StandardScaler, followed by RBF SVC and fitted sigmoid calibration.
endpoint: Recorded peak cTnI >= 70 times the study reference upper limit during postoperative days 1-3; biomarker-defined injury, not a stand-alone diagnosis of myocardial infarction.
use: Research and reproducibility only; not validated for clinical decision-making.
privacy: The application does not request patient identifiers, persist entered values to a database, or log predictor values. Model support vectors remain on the application server; keep the source repository private unless model release has been separately reviewed.
limitations: Historical outcome-informed predictor selection may produce optimistic development estimates.
External validation is preliminary; assay equivalence and individual predictor measurement times were not fully verified.
The cryoprecipitate field preserves the manuscript-reported mL scale; the original unit mapping could not be independently verified. Do not substitute units or bags.
ASA is the historical III-versus-IV encoding. Other ASA classes are not represented as separate categories.
No treatment benefit from model-guided decisions or a protective oxycodone effect is established.
deployment: Python Streamlit interface loading the original frozen fitted joblib bundle; no retraining or recalibration.
calculator_missing_data: This interface requires complete input for all ten predictors. The fitted estimator is evaluated directly after exact-order assembly; no missing entries are accepted. Initial form values are illustrative only. The original fitted imputers remain in the model bundle.
